title: Retire or convert character-creation overlays to oracle tests
description:
Thaw scope #9. Once the importer emits ASIs, languages, spellcasting ability/prep, and starting equipment (.5) and the pack is regenerated/re-frozen (.14), remove the overlays' RUNTIME usage so no deterministic character-creation fact is sourced from outside the generated pack.

PREFERRED end state is CONVERSION, not blind deletion: the source-cited constants in packages/core/src/character/srd{AncestryAbilityScoreIncreases,ClassSpellcasting,ClassStartingEquipment,Languages}.ts are valuable as REGRESSION ORACLES. Convert them into tests that assert generated pack data matches those expected source-derived values, then delete the runtime code paths that consumed them. Only fully delete a file when its constants add no oracle value beyond what a pack-vs-source test already covers. Net result: zero runtime overlay dependence, oracle coverage preserved.
